verdict.rationale: Codex supports cloud tasks started from web/GitHub/Slack that can be continued via 'Start and review work from the web or Codex CLI', and CLI supports resuming recent chats from a repository, suggesting cross-device continuity. However, there's no explicit evidence of seamless session sync across devices/browsers beyond starting cloud tasks and later inspecting/reviewing them, and some 'resume' features are described as local-only (per-repository chat history).
